support_functions.prosrc: BEGIN UPDATE wb.project SET access_scope_revision=access_scope_revision+1 WHERE project_id=COALESCE(NEW.project_id,OLD.project_id); IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.project_id<>NEW.project_id THEN UPDATE wb.project SET access_scope_revision=access_scope_revision+1 WHERE project_id=OLD.project_id; END IF; RETURN NULL; END
BEGIN IF NEW.release_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.release_date THEN NEW.relation_revision=OLD.relation_revision+1; END IF; RETURN NEW; END
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'APPEND_ONLY' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END
BEGIN UPDATE wb.release_batch SET relation_revision=relation_revision+1 WHERE project_id=NEW.project_id AND batch_id=NEW.batch_id; RETURN NULL; END
